name: ambiguous-commit-lookup-then-insert
description: Recovery by reconciliation: after the lost COMMIT the client reads durable state (is there a payment for this request?) and only inserts when there is none. Safe for one client.

actors.name: Client
actors.description: a client that submits the same payment again when it gets no answer

invariants.name: charged-once
invariants.description: one logical payment is recorded at most once
